assets.//: Run the Worker first only where it does something: page URLs (Markdown content negotiation, Vary: Accept) and /api/event. Static files with the extensions below, plus /.well-known/*, are excluded via negative rules and served directly by the asset layer (_headers and _redirects still apply); anything unlisted still runs the Worker. Each Worker run counts against the account's daily request cap, and feed readers, crawlers, and favicons are most of the non-page traffic. In these patterns `*` matches any characters, including `/`, so `!/*.xml` covers .xml files at any depth. Never exclude a pattern that can match a page (paths ending in /) or /api/event; worker/routing.test.js guards this.
